integrity: Analytic recurrence proof, gamma asymptotics, finite exact-rational diagnostic; no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only invariant diagonal Schatten subspaces, not whole Schatten ideal. Prior bounded-diagonal spectral disks and ordinary Bergman Hilbert–Schmidt arc are credited; novelty is the full beta-weight/Schatten-exponent boundary threshold and critical weak-Schatten behavior. A broader shift theorem may cover components.
title: Sharp Schatten boundary eigenarcs for beta-weighted Bergman harmonic-Toeplitz dynamics
